Name: Hatchable Rabbits
Author: stardemod
Description:
This mod changes the Rabbit's Foot into an Easter Egg, so rabbits no longer have to lose their feet to make villagers happy on their birthday. Additionally, this mod allows you to place the Easter Eggs in the incubator, and after 2 weeks, a new rabbit appears in the coop. This makes all coop animals reproducible and obtainable without relying on Marnie.

This mod only changes the appearance and name of the Rabbit's Foot item; no quests will be disturbed.
